resolution.note: ci wait awaits a rerun attempt of a failed run; bubblewrap install retries 4 times with pauses

title: ci wait follows rerun attempts and CI setup survives a transient bubblewrap install failure
body:
Why: on PR #615 run 43047640047 attempt 1 failed 14 jobs at "Set up CI" with "bubblewrap install failed" (infra), and after `gh run rerun --failed` `bin/krn ci wait` kept returning the attempt-1 failure for the head, so lanes cannot wait on a rerun and the guard forbids polling. #613 handled a run cancelled by a newer run, not a newer attempt of the same run.
Outcome: ci wait and pr ship read the latest attempt of the newest gate run for the head and wait while it runs; the bubblewrap install in .github/actions/setup-ci retries transient package failures (or uses a cached package) so this flake stops failing whole runs.
Proof: test/ci/wait.test.ts covers a failed attempt 1 followed by a running then green attempt 2; the setup step retry is covered by its action test or a script test.
